trial_title: Sorafenib in Treating Patients With Relapsed Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia
brief_summary: Sorafenib may stop the growth of cancer cells by blocking some of the enzymes needed for cell growth and by blocking blood flow to the cancer. This phase II trial is studying how well sorafenib works in treating patients with relapsed chronic lymphocytic leukemia.

eligibility_table.criterion: Histologically or cytologically confirmed chronic lymphocytic leukemia (CLL) by NCI-WG immunophenotype and blood criteria
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a confirmed diagnosis of CLL as indicated by their medical history.

eligibility_table.criterion: Documentation of current or prior peripheral blood (PB) or bone marrow (BM) immunophenotype compatible with CLL
eligibility_table.justification: There is no documentation provided regarding current or prior PB or BM immunophenotype.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a documented immunophenotype in peripheral blood or bone marrow that shows co-expression of CD5 and CD23, along with weak expression of FMC-7, consistent with chronic lymphocytic leukemia?

eligibility_table.criterion: Patients who currently do not have > 5,000/mm³ absolute lymphocytosis are eligible if they have previously met PB lymphocytosis criteria and have a current immunophenotype documenting monoclonal B lymphocytosis morphologically and immunophenotypically compatible with CLL
eligibility_table.justification: The patient has a history of elevated white count and has previously met PB lymphocytosis criteria.

eligibility_table.justification: The patient does not meet the criteria for Rai stage II as there is no mention of splenomegaly or hepatomegaly.

eligibility_table.criterion: Rai stage III disease with lymphocytosis plus anemia

eligibility_table.criterion: Rai stage IV disease with lymphocytosis and thrombocytopenia
eligibility_table.justification: The patient's current blood counts are not provided, making it unclear if they meet Rai stage IV criteria.

eligibility_table.criterion: Extreme fatigue (i.e., ECOG performance status 2: cannot work or unable to perform usual activities)
